entry.title: GitLab Patch Release: 18.4.1, 18.3.3, 18.2.7
entry.content:
Today we are releasing versions 18.4.1, 18.3.3, and 18.2.7 for GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE).

These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to one of these versions immediately.

entry.title: GitLab 18.4 released with Duo Agent Platform improvements and a faster merge train
entry.content: Today, we are excited to announce the release of GitLab 18.4 with improvements to merge trains, a new pipeline inputs editor, and Duo Agent Platform updates.
